create_wod_easy_env: create a MiniHackWoDEasy environment with a wand of death and an asleep minotaur on a small map
create_wod_medium_env: create a MiniHackWoDMedium environment with a longer corridor map and a minotaur at the far end
create_wod_hard_env: create a MiniHackWoDHard environment with a safe room area and a minotaur in a maze-like layout
create_wod_pro_env: create a MiniHackWoDPro environment with a complex multi-room maze and a minotaur to defeat
register_wod_environment: register a new Wand of Death environment variant using the register function with an id and entry point
